name: Мероприятия
changes: Restore German localized fields on edit; preserve primary occurrence ID and cancellation status.
Preserve scheduledAt, full schema metadata and counters across actual mock repository update/read; keep server cancellation metadata in image copies.
Validate optional fields, participation, price and schedule at submission; enter busy state before geocoding; disable editor navigation during submission.
Warn before discarding edited fields; load exact saved detail without replacing previously cached pages.
Today/week filters use session overlap, ignore cancelled sessions and apply to past results; show loading before the first response and retain explicit retry after failures.
Preserve totals when loading the latest 100 comments; avoid double counter changes after concurrent refresh; scope recommendation cache by content revision.
Block unusable-account interactions; propagate organization repository through event list, related events and editor.
Load participant profiles only when the participant screen is requested; explicit retry and stale-response account guard.
Use primary body text color; stack metadata, organizer and primary actions at accessibility sizes.
Keep all-day dates stable across repeated edits, including extra sessions; show inclusive last day without midnight.
Discard staged calendar changes on failure; exclude cancelled sessions from calendar fallback; validate map coordinates.
